theorems.name: Submission.tdo_slb_setLIntegral_rpow_le_holder
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (B : Set X) (g : X → ℝ≥0∞) (p q : ℝ), 0 < q → q ≤ p → ∫⁻ x in B, g x ^ q ∂μ ≤ (∫⁻ x in B, g x ^ p ∂μ) ^ (q / p) * μ B ^ (1 - q / p)
